reviews.title: Great choice for FPS
reviews.comment: This is a solid device that works great for gaming. Will it improve your performance in FPS games? Who knows, but it’s very light, there’s no latency, and the battery life while not otherworldly, is still pretty good. Great value for the price.
reviews.author: Tod S.

reviews.title: Goated budget mouse
reviews.comment: Bought this after seeing it recommended by DiamondLobby Reviews and being cheap already, they also offered a ~$10 coupon, so I paid like $30 for the R1 Pro. Took awhile to arrive, but it rivals my Asus Harpe II Ace in terms of performance for $130 less. Goes to show you don't have to pay huge amounts of money to get good performance out of a mouse - and not even just performance - the build quality and feel are top notch as well. Switches feel great, no rattles when shaken, scroll wheel feels great, clicks are crisp and responsive. And all at ~50g, so it's light weight. So far so good for that price! Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Michael A. Bower Jr

reviews.title: Incredible value.
reviews.comment:
This mouse is about 95% as good as some of the most popular FPS gaming mice on the market like the Pulsar Crazylight or Logitech ProX Superlight 2, but it costs well under half the price.
The soft braided cable it comes with is great, and they give you the adapter to attach the wireless receiver right to the end of the cable, so it's super easy to pop off the receiver and plug the mouse in when you need to charge it, then pop the receiver back on to go back to wireless mode.  Very convenient.
I love that you don't need to install configuration software, you just head to the website to configure it in a browser (all peripheral manufacturers should be doing this).
I've been using it for about 6 months so far, and the coating still looks and feels brand new.
Overall, super happy with it.
reviews.author: Bardo

reviews.title: Would buy again, extra goodies cherry on-top
reviews.comment: The mouse is very light, it helps a lot with ergonomics. Its very responsive, although you have to tweak around the settings for a while to get the feedback you want. It comes with the usual stuff, but it came with mouse grips and a very good quality wire that is also the cherry on the cake. The scroll wheel is very nice, its not the typical scroll wheels you get on low range mice. Very easy to connect to as you can use USB or USB C. I would buy again.
reviews.author: Russell C.

reviews.title: Decent mouse upgrade for a budget
reviews.comment:
Pretty ergonomic mouse for me.
It was my first time considering to purchase a lightweight mouse. I took my chances with this after lurking for a while and thanks to a minimal discount, went for it. Coming from a G305, this mouse feels like a fresh air for my grip. I've been using it for 10 days without plugging it and still holds some charge even when it came around 75% battery level which was my main concern since my last mouse uses AA/AAA batteries and it takes months to replace for low battery levels. I can get used to it if lasts 2 weeks per charge.
The coating feels good and I haven't faced any slip. The skates are good but due my hard mousepad I don't think they are gonna last. Glad they send some replacements. The pairing throught web browser is a blessing but it will be perfect if Firefox/based browser could be compatible (at least for me didn't work on Firefox nor Zen).
